summary: We are FiveCore--Computer Engineering students from Rivne region. We developed a site where you can find information about technologies sent into space; play a mini--game; interact with a 3D models. Our site adresses the challenge dirrectly--it contains all basics about space tech and gives the user an opportunity to easily get any needed information. It`s quite useful for anyone who is interested in space exploration and technology, especially for astronomy students.
details: Our project was made to help people who are interested in NASA space technologies find information without browsing a lot of sites. We used AI tools to assist with development, VS Code as our code editor, and Vercel for deployment and hosting. The project was built on standard laptops/PCs using html, css and javascript.
